name: Cat Tag Jump Only UP
detailed_description:
Climb higher and higher in this exhilarating VR parkour adventure as a fearless cat! Use your hands to grab onto surfaces, climb, and push off just like a real feline. The harder you push, the higher you jump! Experience the thrill of movement as you navigate through a variety of stunning environments, from the familiar comfort of a cozy home to the chaos of a farm with flying vegetables, the endless skies filled with airplanes, and even the vast, mysterious depths of space. But your journey won't be easy—tricky piggies are out to stop you! These relentless foes will charge at you the moment they see you, forcing you to think fast and fight back. But don’t worry—you have powerful paws! Swing at them with a swift motion to knock them away and clear your path upward.

Every level is a new challenge filled with obstacles to overcome, hidden paths to discover, and mind-bending landscapes that defy reality. The further you climb, the stranger and more surreal your surroundings become—floating islands, shifting platforms, and even gravity-defying structures that will push your parkour skills to the limit. Master precise movements, time your jumps perfectly, and adapt to the ever-changing world around you.

With immersive VR mechanics, intuitive controls, and a dynamic movement system, this game makes you feel like a real cat—climbing, leaping, and clawing your way to victory. Will you conquer the heights and reach the ultimate peak? The final challenge awaits!
